topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impacts link budget calculations by increasing the required transmit power to maintain the same signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This is due to the reduced antenna gain, affecting the overall signal quality and capacity. The increased transmit power may lead to heat generation and potential interference with other systems, ultimately degrading the system's capacity and spectral efficiency. The reduced antenna efficiency necessitates adjustments to the frequency reuse and multiple access schemes to compensate for the decreased signal quality. The tradeoff between coding gain and modulation order is affected, impacting the system's ability to adapt to changing channel conditions and optimize data transmission rates.
